```{r}
##########################################################
# Xenium: SnC + cell type annotation + plots
# (parallel to your 4i / CODEX workflow)
##########################################################

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(Seurat)
  library(dplyr)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(scales)
  library(ggpubr)
  library(pheatmap)
})

# ---- set working dir (edit if needed) ----
load("/home/ext_han_yeaeun_mayo_edu/skin_mapping/data/260311.RData")
save.image("/home/ext_han_yeaeun_mayo_edu/skin_mapping/data/260311.RData")



# ---- load split violin geom (your plotfunctions.R) ----
source("../shared/plotfunctions.R")  # must define geom_split_violin()

# ---- your Xenium Seurat object ----
# assume it exists in the environment as: hsskin.ST
# (if you need to load it, add: hsskin.ST <- readRDS("path/to/xenium.rds"))

# =========================
# 1) Choose assay/layer conventions
# =========================
# positivity calls: use Xenium counts (true detection)
assay_pos  <- if ("Xenium" %in% Assays(hsskin.ST)) "Xenium" else DefaultAssay(hsskin.ST)
layer_pos  <- "counts"

# plotting expression: use SCT normalized (smooth distribution)
assay_plot <- if ("SCT" %in% Assays(hsskin.ST)) "SCT" else DefaultAssay(hsskin.ST)
layer_plot <- "data"

# =========================
# 2) Helper: marker positivity (counts > 0) with graceful fallback
# =========================
get_pos <- function(obj, feature, assay = "Xenium", layer = "counts") {
  if (!assay %in% Assays(obj)) {
    stop(paste("Assay not found:", assay))
  }
  if (!feature %in% rownames(obj[[assay]])) {
    return(setNames(rep(FALSE, ncol(obj)), colnames(obj)))
  }
  m <- LayerData(obj, assay = assay, layer = layer)[feature, ]
  setNames(as.numeric(m) > 0, names(m))
}

# =========================
# 3) Marker mapping (Xenium gene symbols)
# =========================
sasp_genes <- c(
"CCL11","CCL13","CCL14","CCL15","CCL16","CCL19","CCL2","CCL20","CCL21",
"CCL26","CCL28","CCL3","CCL3L1","CCL4","CCL5","CCL7","CCL8",
"CXCL1","CXCL10","CXCL11","CXCL12","CXCL13","CXCL14","CXCL16","CXCL2",
"CXCL3","CXCL5","CXCL6","CXCL9",
"IL12B","IL13","IL15","IL18","IL1A","IL1B","IL2","IL23A","IL4","IL5","IL6",
"MMP12","MMP9","MMP3",
"VEGFA","TNF","TGFB1","CSF1","EGF","FGF2","IFNB1","CMKLR1"
)

# keep only genes present in Xenium panel
sasp_genes_present <- intersect(sasp_genes, rownames(hsskin.ST))

cat("SASP genes detected in panel:", length(sasp_genes_present), "\n")

# binary SASP positivity matrix
sasp_matrix <- GetAssayData(
  object = hsskin.ST, 
  assay = "Xenium", 
  layer = "counts"  # In Seurat v4 this is slot = "counts"
)[sasp_genes_present, ]

sasp_binary <- sasp_matrix > 0

# number of SASP genes expressed per cell
hsskin.ST$sasp_num <- colSums(sasp_binary)


# Senescence markers
p21   <- get_pos(hsskin.ST, "CDKN1A", assay_pos, layer_pos)  # p21
p16   <- get_pos(hsskin.ST, "CDKN2A", assay_pos, layer_pos)  # p16
PCNA  <- get_pos(hsskin.ST, "PCNA",   assay_pos, layer_pos)
MKI67  <- get_pos(hsskin.ST, "MKI67",   assay_pos, layer_pos)
IP10  <- get_pos(hsskin.ST, "CXCL10", assay_pos, layer_pos)  # IP-10 gene
CXCR3 <- get_pos(hsskin.ST, "CXCR3",  assay_pos, layer_pos)

# Sub-senescence / nuclear markers (for plotting)
BCL2  <- get_pos(hsskin.ST, "BCL2",   assay_pos, layer_pos)
HMGB1 <- get_pos(hsskin.ST, "HMGB1",  assay_pos, layer_pos)
LMNB1 <- get_pos(hsskin.ST, "LMNB1",  assay_pos, layer_pos)  # LaminB1 gene

# Skin markers
MelanA    <- get_pos(hsskin.ST, "MLANA", assay_pos, layer_pos) # MelanA
Vimentin  <- get_pos(hsskin.ST, "VIM",   assay_pos, layer_pos) # Vimentin
Keratin5  <- get_pos(hsskin.ST, "KRT5",  assay_pos, layer_pos) # Keratin 5
Keratin10 <- get_pos(hsskin.ST, "KRT10", assay_pos, layer_pos) # Keratin 10
Filaggrin <- get_pos(hsskin.ST, "FLG",   assay_pos, layer_pos) # Filaggrin
SMA       <- get_pos(hsskin.ST, "ACTA2", assay_pos, layer_pos) # SMA / ACTA2

# =========================
# 4) Annotate SnC + skin cell types (same conventions as 4i/CODEX)
# =========================
hsskin.ST$snc <- ifelse(((p21 | p16) & !(PCNA | MKI67) & hsskin.ST$sasp_num >= 5), "SnC+", "SnC-")
#hsskin.ST$snc2 <- ifelse(((p21 | p16) & !(PCNA | MKI67) & (BCL2) & hsskin.ST$sasp_num >= 5), "SnC+", "SnC-")
hsskin.ST$snc <- factor(hsskin.ST$snc, levels = c("SnC-", "SnC+"))
#hsskin.ST$snc2 <- factor(hsskin.ST$snc2, levels = c("SnC-", "SnC+"))

hsskin.ST$majorskincell <- dplyr::case_when(
  MelanA ~ "Melanocyte",
  SMA ~ "Smooth Muscle",
  Vimentin ~ "Fibroblast",
  (Keratin5 | Keratin10 | Filaggrin) ~ "Keratinocyte",
  TRUE ~ "none"
)

hsskin.ST$minorskincell <- dplyr::case_when(
  MelanA ~ "Melanocyte",
  SMA ~ "Smooth Muscle",
  Vimentin ~ "Fibroblast",
  Keratin5 ~ "Basal Keratinocyte",
  Keratin10 ~ "Suprabasal Keratinocyte",
  Filaggrin ~ "Corneocyte",
  TRUE ~ "none"
)

# Inversed anatomical order (deep -> superficial), with "none" first
hsskin.ST$majorskincell <- factor(
  hsskin.ST$majorskincell,
  levels = c("none", "Smooth Muscle", "Fibroblast", "Melanocyte", "Keratinocyte")
)
hsskin.ST$minorskincell <- factor(
  hsskin.ST$minorskincell,
  levels = c("none", "Smooth Muscle", "Fibroblast", "Melanocyte",
             "Basal Keratinocyte", "Suprabasal Keratinocyte", "Corneocyte")
)

# Optional combined labels (if you later want them)
if ("age" %in% colnames(hsskin.ST@meta.data)) {
  hsskin.ST$age_major <- paste(hsskin.ST$age, hsskin.ST$majorskincell, sep = " ")
  hsskin.ST$age_minor <- paste(hsskin.ST$age, hsskin.ST$minorskincell, sep = " ")
}
```


```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(scales)

blue_col <- "#296d9e"

# 1) Derive age from sample suffix (-Y / -O)
hsskin.ST$age <- dplyr::case_when(
  grepl("-Y$", hsskin.ST$sample) ~ "Young",
  grepl("-O$", hsskin.ST$sample) ~ "Old",
  TRUE ~ NA_character_
)
hsskin.ST$age <- factor(hsskin.ST$age, levels = c("Young", "Old"))

# 2) Sample-level SnC proportion (each dot = sample)
df_xen_samples <- hsskin.ST@meta.data %>%
  filter(!is.na(sample) & !is.na(age)) %>%
  group_by(age, sample) %>%
  summarise(
    snc_prop = mean(snc2 == "SnC+", na.rm = TRUE),
    n_cells = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# 3) Nature-style bar plot: mean ± SEM + sample dots
ymax <- max(df_xen_samples$snc_prop, na.rm = TRUE) * 1.15

p_age <- ggplot(df_xen_samples, aes(x = age, y = snc_prop)) +
  stat_summary(fun = mean, geom = "bar", width = 0.6,
               fill = blue_col, color = "black") +
  stat_summary(fun.data = mean_se, geom = "errorbar", width = 0.15,
               linewidth = 0.8, color = "black") +
  geom_point(position = position_jitter(width = 0.07),
             size = 3, color = "black") +
  scale_y_continuous(
    limits = c(0, ymax),
    breaks = pretty(c(0, ymax), n = 4),
    labels = percent_format(accuracy = 0.1),
    expand = c(0, 0)
  ) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = NULL) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 18)

print(p_age)

# optional save
ggsave("results/260225/xenium_snc_age.pdf", plot = p_age, width = 3.6, height = 4.2, dpi = 500)

# sanity check table
df_xen_samples %>% arrange(age, sample)
```




```{r}
# =========================
# 6) Split violins: BCL2 / HMGB1 / LMNB1 by SnC (use SCT "data")
# =========================
plot_split_violin_marker <- function(obj,
                                     feature,
                                     group_col = "snc",
                                     assay = "SCT",
                                     layer = "data",
                                     cols = c("SnC-" = "#296d9e", "SnC+" = "#cc0b01")) {

  df <- FetchData(obj, vars = c(feature, group_col), assay = assay, layer = layer)
  colnames(df) <- c("value", "group")
  df <- df %>%
    filter(!is.na(group)) %>%
    mutate(group = factor(group, levels = c("SnC-", "SnC+")))

  df$feature_name <- feature

  ggplot(df, aes(x = feature_name, y = value, fill = group)) +
    geom_split_violin(scale = "width", trim = TRUE, alpha = 0.9) +
    geom_boxplot(width = 0.15, outliers = FALSE, fill = "white") +
    stat_compare_means(aes(group = group), method = "wilcox.test",
                       label = "p.signif", size = 5) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = cols) +
    theme_classic(base_size = 18) +
    theme(
      legend.position = "none",
      axis.title.x = element_blank(),
      axis.text.x = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
      axis.title.y = element_text(size = 14)
    ) +
    labs(y = paste0("Expression (", assay, " ", layer, ")"))
}

features <- c("BCL2", "HMGB1", "LMNB1")

# Only plot features that exist in the plotting assay
features_present <- features[features %in% rownames(hsskin.ST[[assay_plot]])]
if (length(features_present) > 0) {
  p_list <- lapply(features_present, function(f) plot_split_violin_marker(
    obj = hsskin.ST,
    feature = f,
    group_col = "snc",
    assay = assay_plot,
    layer = layer_plot
  ))

  final_plot <- Reduce(`+`, p_list)
  print(final_plot)
} else {
  warning("None of BCL2/HMGB1/LMNB1 found in plotting assay. Check assay_plot/feature names.")
}

# =========================
# 7) Save object (optional)
# =========================
# saveRDS(hsskin.ST, file = "data/xenium/hsskin_ST_annotated.rds")
```

```{r}
##########################################################
# SASP DEG analysis between Young vs Old SnC cells
##########################################################
hsskin.ST2 <- UpdateSeuratObject(hsskin.ST)
DefaultAssay(hsskin.ST2) <- "Xenium"

# Ensure Xenium "data" exists (log-normalized) for FindMarkers(slot="data")
hsskin.ST2 <- NormalizeData(hsskin.ST2, assay = "Xenium",
                            normalization.method = "LogNormalize",
                            scale.factor = 1e4, verbose = FALSE)

# make sure age exists + snc2 exists
stopifnot("age" %in% colnames(hsskin.ST2@meta.data))
stopifnot("snc2" %in% colnames(hsskin.ST2@meta.data))

# SASP genes present in panel
sasp_genes_present <- intersect(sasp_genes_present, rownames(hsskin.ST2[["Xenium"]]))

run_within_age_deg <- function(obj, age_value, snc_col = "snc2", genes = NULL) {

  if (is.null(genes)) {
    genes <- rownames(obj[["Xenium"]])  # fallback: all genes in Xenium assay
  }

  md <- obj@meta.data
  keep_cells <- rownames(md)[md$age == age_value & !is.na(md[[snc_col]])]

  x <- subset(obj, cells = keep_cells)
  Idents(x) <- factor(x@meta.data[[snc_col]], levels = c("SnC-", "SnC+"))

  print(table(Idents(x)))

  FindMarkers(
    x,
    ident.1 = "SnC+",
    ident.2 = "SnC-",
    features = genes,
    assay = "Xenium",
    slot = "data",
    test.use = "wilcox",
    logfc.threshold = 0,
    min.pct = 0.05
  ) %>%
    tibble::rownames_to_column("gene") %>%
    arrange(p_val_adj, p_val)
}

deg_young <- run_within_age_deg(hsskin.ST2, "Young")
deg_old   <- run_within_age_deg(hsskin.ST2, "Old")

topN <- 20

top_young <- deg_young %>%
  arrange(p_val_adj, desc(abs(avg_log2FC))) %>%
  slice_head(n = topN) %>%
  pull(gene)

top_old <- deg_old %>%
  arrange(p_val_adj, desc(abs(avg_log2FC))) %>%
  slice_head(n = topN) %>%
  pull(gene)

young_obj <- subset(hsskin.ST2, subset = age == "Young")
Idents(young_obj) <- young_obj$snc2

# Example usage (Young: SnC+ vs SnC-)
Idents(young_obj) <- young_obj$snc2  # or snc
genes_to_plot <- top_young        # or top_young

p_young <- DotPlot(
  young_obj,
  features = genes_to_plot,
  assay = "Xenium",
  dot.scale = 6,
  scale = FALSE
) +
  scale_color_gradientn(
    colours = c("lightgray","#9ecae1","#3182bd","#08519c")
  ) +
  theme(
    axis.title = element_blank(),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 9)
  )

p_young <- p_young +
  theme(
    legend.position = "right",
    legend.justification = c(0, 0.9),
    legend.key.height = unit(0.3, "cm"),
    legend.box.spacing = unit(0.2, "cm"),
    legend.margin = margin(0, 0, 0, 0),
    plot.margin = margin(5.5, 30, 5.5, 5.5)   # add right margin
  )

ggsave(
  "young_snc_dotplot.png",
  p_young,
  width = 7.8,   # slightly wider
  height = 2.3,
  dpi = 300,
  bg = "white"
)

old_obj <- subset(hsskin.ST2, subset = age == "Old")
Idents(old_obj) <- old_obj$snc2

# Example usage (old: SnC+ vs SnC-)
Idents(old_obj) <- old_obj$snc2  # or snc
genes_to_plot <- top_old        #

p_old <- DotPlot(
  old_obj,
  features = genes_to_plot,
  assay = "Xenium",
  dot.scale = 6,
  scale = TRUE
) +
  scale_color_gradientn(
    colours = c("lightgray","#9ecae1","#3182bd","#08519c")
  ) +
  theme(
    axis.title = element_blank(),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 9)
  )

p_old <- p_old +
  theme(
    legend.position = "right",
    legend.justification = c(0, 0.9),
    legend.key.height = unit(0.3, "cm"),
    legend.box.spacing = unit(0.2, "cm"),
    legend.margin = margin(0, 0, 0, 0),
    plot.margin = margin(5.5, 30, 5.5, 5.5)   # add right margin
  )

ggsave(
  "old_snc_dotplot.png",
  p_old,
  width = 7.8,   # slightly wider
  height = 2.4,
  dpi = 300,
  bg = "white"
)
```

```{r}
  mutate(abs_log2FC = abs(avg_log2FC)) %>%
  arrange(p_val_adj, p_val, desc(abs_log2FC)) %>%
```

```{r}
BiocManager::install("EnhancedVolcano")

library(Seurat)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggrepel)   # Essential for volcano plots so gene labels don't overlap!
library(patchwork)
library(EnhancedVolcano)

# Define your columns
celltype_col <- "cell_type_major"
snc_col <- "snc"
age_col <- "age"

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 1. Define a universal Volcano Plot function
# ---------------------------------------------------------
make_volcano <- function(deg_df, plot_title) {
  
  # Set thresholds (0.1 logFC is good for targeted Xenium data)
  fc_threshold <- 0.1
  pval_threshold <- 0.05
  
  # Create a significance grouping column
  deg_df$Significance <- "Not Sig"
  deg_df$Significance[deg_df$p_val_adj < pval_threshold & deg_df$avg_log2FC > fc_threshold] <- "Up"
  deg_df$Significance[deg_df$p_val_adj < pval_threshold & deg_df$avg_log2FC < -fc_threshold] <- "Down"
  
  # Extract gene names from rownames
  deg_df$gene <- rownames(deg_df)
  
  # Filter only the significant genes for text labeling
  sig_genes <- deg_df %>% filter(Significance != "Not Sig")
  
  # Build the plot
  p <- ggplot(deg_df, aes(x = avg_log2FC, y = -log10(p_val_adj), color = Significance)) +
    geom_point(alpha = 0.7, size = 1.5) +
    scale_color_manual(values = c("Up" = "#cc0b01", "Down" = "#08519c", "Not Sig" = "grey80")) +
    
    # Add threshold lines
    geom_vline(xintercept = c(-fc_threshold, fc_threshold), linetype = "dashed", color = "black", alpha = 0.5) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(pval_threshold), linetype = "dashed", color = "black", alpha = 0.5) +
    
    # Add repelled text labels for significant genes
    geom_text_repel(
      data = sig_genes,
      aes(label = gene),
      size = 3, 
      max.overlaps = 20,
      box.padding = 0.5
    ) +
    
    theme_classic(base_size = 14) +
    labs(
      title = plot_title,
      x = "Log2 Fold Change",
      y = "-Log10(Adj P-value)"
    ) +
    theme(
      legend.position = "none",
      plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5)
    )
  
  return(p)
}

# Get a clean list of the major cell types
major_types <- unique(na.omit(hsskin.ST@meta.data[[celltype_col]]))

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 2. Volcano Plots: Old vs Young (within each cell type)
# ---------------------------------------------------------
# Create combined identity: e.g., "Fibroblast_Old"
hsskin.ST$celltype_age <- paste0(hsskin.ST@meta.data[[celltype_col]], "_", hsskin.ST@meta.data[[age_col]])
Idents(hsskin.ST) <- "celltype_age"

volcanos_age <- list()

for (ct in major_types) {
  ident_old <- paste0(ct, "_Old")
  ident_young <- paste0(ct, "_Young")
  
  # Safety check: Ensure both groups actually have cells before running math
  if (ident_old %in% levels(Idents(hsskin.ST)) && ident_young %in% levels(Idents(hsskin.ST))) {
    
    # min.pct = 0 and logfc.threshold = 0 forces Seurat to return ALL genes for the volcano shape
    degs <- FindMarkers(hsskin.ST, ident.1 = ident_old, ident.2 = ident_young, 
                        min.pct = 0, logfc.threshold = 0)
    
    # Generate the plot and store it in the list
    volcanos_age[[ct]] <- make_volcano(degs, paste0(ct, "\nOld vs Young"))
  }
}

# Print all Age volcanos in a grid
print(wrap_plots(volcanos_age, ncol = 5))

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 3. Volcano Plots: SnC+ vs SnC- (within each cell type)
# ---------------------------------------------------------
# Create combined identity: e.g., "Fibroblast_SnC+"
hsskin.ST$celltype_snc <- paste0(hsskin.ST@meta.data[[celltype_col]], "_", hsskin.ST@meta.data[[snc_col]])
Idents(hsskin.ST) <- "celltype_snc"

volcanos_snc <- list()

for (ct in major_types) {
  ident_snc_pos <- paste0(ct, "_SnC+")
  ident_snc_neg <- paste0(ct, "_SnC-")
  
  # Safety check: Ensure the cell type actually has SnC+ cells
  if (ident_snc_pos %in% levels(Idents(hsskin.ST)) && ident_snc_neg %in% levels(Idents(hsskin.ST))) {
    
    # Find all markers
    degs <- FindMarkers(hsskin.ST, ident.1 = ident_snc_pos, ident.2 = ident_snc_neg, 
                        min.pct = 0, logfc.threshold = 0)
    
    # Generate the plot and store it
    volcanos_snc[[ct]] <- make_volcano(degs, paste0(ct, "\nSnC+ vs SnC-"))
  }
}

# Print all SnC volcanos in a grid
print(wrap_plots(volcanos_snc, ncol = 3))
```

```{r}
# Make sure it's installed if you haven't yet:
# BiocManager::install("EnhancedVolcano")

library(Seurat)
library(dplyr)
library(EnhancedVolcano)
library(patchwork)

celltype_col <- "cell_type_major"
snc_col <- "snc"
age_col <- "age"

# Get a clean list of the major cell types
major_types <- unique(na.omit(hsskin.ST@meta.data[[celltype_col]]))

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 1. Volcano Plots: Old vs Young (within each cell type)
# ---------------------------------------------------------
hsskin.ST$celltype_age <- paste0(hsskin.ST@meta.data[[celltype_col]], "_", hsskin.ST@meta.data[[age_col]])
Idents(hsskin.ST) <- "celltype_age"

volcanos_age <- list()

for (ct in major_types) {
  ident_old <- paste0(ct, "_Old")
  ident_young <- paste0(ct, "_Young")
  
  if (ident_old %in% levels(Idents(hsskin.ST)) && ident_young %in% levels(Idents(hsskin.ST))) {
    
    # Pull all genes for the volcano shape
    degs <- FindMarkers(hsskin.ST, ident.1 = ident_old, ident.2 = ident_young, 
                        min.pct = 0, logfc.threshold = 0)
    
    # Generate the EnhancedVolcano plot
    volcanos_age[[ct]] <- EnhancedVolcano(
      degs,
      lab = rownames(degs),
      x = 'avg_log2FC',
      y = 'p_val_adj',                 # Use adjusted p-value!
      title = paste0(ct, "\nOld vs Young"),
      subtitle = NULL,                 # Hide subtitle to save grid space
      caption = NULL,                  # Hide caption to save grid space
      pCutoff = 0.05,
      FCcutoff = 0.1,                  # 0.1 threshold for Xenium
      pointSize = 2.0,
      labSize = 4.0,
      legendPosition = 'none',         # Hide legend to save grid space
      drawConnectors = TRUE,
      widthConnectors = 0.5,
      axisLabSize = 10,
      titleLabSize = 12
    )
  }
}

# Print all Age volcanos in a grid
print(wrap_plots(volcanos_age, ncol = 5))

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 2. Volcano Plots: SnC+ vs SnC- (within each cell type)
# ---------------------------------------------------------
hsskin.ST$celltype_snc <- paste0(hsskin.ST@meta.data[[celltype_col]], "_", hsskin.ST@meta.data[[snc_col]])
Idents(hsskin.ST) <- "celltype_snc"

volcanos_snc <- list()

for (ct in major_types) {
  ident_snc_pos <- paste0(ct, "_SnC+")
  ident_snc_neg <- paste0(ct, "_SnC-")
  
  # Count the actual number of cells in each group
  n_pos <- sum(Idents(hsskin.ST) == ident_snc_pos)
  n_neg <- sum(Idents(hsskin.ST) == ident_snc_neg)
  
  # Only run if BOTH groups have at least 3 cells
  if (n_pos >= 3 && n_neg >= 3) {
    
    degs <- FindMarkers(hsskin.ST, ident.1 = ident_snc_pos, ident.2 = ident_snc_neg, 
                        min.pct = 0, logfc.threshold = 0)
    
    volcanos_snc[[ct]] <- EnhancedVolcano(
      degs,
      lab = rownames(degs),
      x = 'avg_log2FC',
      y = 'p_val_adj',
      title = paste0(ct, "\nSnC+ vs SnC-"),
      subtitle = NULL,
      caption = NULL,
      pCutoff = 0.05,
      FCcutoff = 0.1,
      pointSize = 2.0,
      labSize = 4.0,
      legendPosition = 'none',
      drawConnectors = TRUE,
      widthConnectors = 0.5,
      axisLabSize = 10,
      titleLabSize = 12
    )
  } else {
    cat("Skipping", ct, "(SnC) - not enough cells (SnC+:", n_pos, ", SnC-:", n_neg, ")\n")
  }
}

print(wrap_plots(volcanos_snc, ncol = 5))
```

```{r}
#Volcano plots of old vs young
library(Seurat)

# Put any gene here that was directly used inside your rule logic
gating_genes <- c(
  "CDKN2A", "CDKN1A", "PCNA", "MKI67",
  "CCL2",   "CCL3",   "CCL3L1", "CCL4",   "CCL5",   "CCL7",   "CCL8",

  "IL13", "IL15", "IL18", "IL23A", "TNF", "IFNB1", "CMKLR1", "MMP1", "MMP3",

    degs <- FindMarkers(hsskin.ST, ident.1 = ident_old, ident.2 = ident_young, 
                        min.pct = 0, logfc.threshold = 0)
    
    volcanos_age[[ct]] <- EnhancedVolcano(
```
